title: Concorde: Geometry-Aware Link Prediction via Decoupled Energy Minimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.36204v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Link prediction remains difficult in sparse graphs, where diffusion heuristics lack connectivity and geometric methods suffer spectral instability when coupling learned representations with diffusion operators. We introduce Concorde, an energy-based framework that resolves this by decomposing link likelihood into three structurally decoupled branches: (i) a parameter-free spectral anchor that establishes permutation-invariant topological stability; (ii) a mixed-curvature residual on a learnable $\mathbb{H}^{d_h}_{c_h} \times \mathbb{S}^{d_s}_{c_s}$ product manifold, regularized by a feature-aware Ollivier-Ricci curvature proxy; and (iii) a continuous vector field on the tangent bundle of hyperbolic space for non-local structural alignment across topological gaps. translated_title: Concorde：基于解耦能量最小化的几何感知链路预测
translated_abstract: 链路预测在稀疏图中仍然困难重重：扩散启发式方法缺乏连通性，而几何方法在将学习到的表示与扩散算子耦合时会遭遇谱不稳定性问题。我们提出 Concorde，一个基于能量的框架，通过将链路似然分解为三个结构上解耦的分支来解决这一问题：(i) 无参数的谱锚点，建立置换不变的拓扑稳定性；(ii) 可学习的双曲 × 球面乘积流形上的混合曲率残差，由特征感知的 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率代理进行正则化；(iii) 双曲空间切丛上的连续向量场，用于跨拓扑间隙的非局部结构对齐。这些分支通过学习到的门控机制进行融合，并采用与检索式评估相匹配的 N-pair 排序损失进行训练。在涵盖稀疏、稠密、特征等场景的五个基准数据集上（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出 Concorde 能量框架，通过无参数谱锚点、乘积流形混合曲率残差与双曲切丛连续向量场三个解耦分支的门控融合，实现稀疏图上几何感知且谱稳定的链路预测。
en_tdlr: Concorde is an energy-based framework that achieves geometry-aware link prediction in sparse graphs by decomposing link likelihood into three structurally decoupled branches—a parameter-free spectral anchor, a mixed-curvature residual on a learnable product manifold, and a continuous vector field on the hyperbolic tangent bundle—fused via learned gating.
